description.what: Gift allows part of the trading fees to be assigned to a designated X account owner. The owner can verify the account and register an EVM wallet address through a verification tweet, then claim the fees directly.
how: At token creation, you enter the X handle that will receive the fees.

The account owner posts the exact verification tweet to verify ownership and register the recipient EVM wallet address. Verification text: "Activating Gift for [Token CA]. Fees will go to [Recipient Wallet Address] #Nadfun @nadfunnews"
Once verification is complete, the recipient EVM wallet address is confirmed.
After that, the fees can be claimed directly on nad.fun by the registered address.
rules: The X handle cannot be changed after token creation.
The fee recipient address cannot be changed once it is set.
Fees are not paid out automatically and must be claimed on nad.fun.
If verification or wallet setup is not completed within 7 days of token creation, the fees are redirected to Buyback & Burn.
If you posted the verification tweet but it was not verified, please open a Discord ticket for support.
description.importantNote: After verification, fees must be claimed on nad.fun by the registered address. If verification is not completed within 7 days, fees will be redirected to Buyback & Burn. Nad.fun is not responsible for fees redirected due to verification issues after the 7 days time limit.
